sources.ref: NCERT Class 11 Physics Part I, Ch 2 Motion in a Straight Line (2026-27 reprint)

notes: Images generated with Agnes AI through the visual-director presets, reviewed against the checklist and content-qa. Provenance (prompts, hashes, rounds) is in tools/content-research/media/agnes-log.json. Delivered as WebP (3:2 at 1536x1024); originals kept outside the repo. Sim requests are open for sim-builder (status requested, not built); until a sim is approved the card shows its fallback text and image.

requests.brief: New sim (no existing sim fits; check PhET HTML5 sims first as sim-builder says). Concept: phy.motion-straight-line.acceleration.core.acceleration-graphs, also used for equations-of-motion. Learning goal: see one constant-acceleration motion as a cart on a straight track and, side by side, its live x-t, v-t and a-t graphs; learn that the slope of x-t is v, the slope of v-t is a, the area under v-t is displacement, and that the cart can be at rest (v = 0) while a is not zero. Model: x = x0 + u t + a t^2 / 2, v = u + a t, a constant; path length integrates |v|. Params: x0 (m, default 0), u (m/s, -20 to 20, default 10), a (m/s^2, -5 to 5, default -2), t_max (s, default 10). Controls: sliders for u and a, play/pause, step by 0.1 s, reset; a time cursor on the graphs. Shade the v-t area above the axis and below it in different patterns, not colour alone. Measurements the card reads at the current time: time (s), position (m), velocity (m/s), acceleration (m/s^2), displacement (m), path_length (m). Card tasks with u = 10, a = -2: time when v = 0 is 5 s; position then 25 m; position at t = 10 s is 0 m; path_length at t = 10 s is 50 m. Model tests: these four values, and v-t slope equal to a. Reduced motion: step through instead of auto-play.
